summary: Iteration 14 — final verification pass of (A) iteration-13 Gateway/Stripe DB collection bug fix AND (B) new IP Protection Layer (Proof of Origin, watermark middleware, DID, copyright headers, proprietary license). BACKEND (20/20 phase14 pytest in 1.9s serially): (A) FIXED — POST /api/solidarity/campaigns/{cid}/checkout with test key now returns HTTP 503 with detail 'stripe_key_missing: Reálne platby vyžadujú platný Stripe kľúč…' (previously 404 collection mismatch). Verified end-to-end: created a fresh campaign via /solidarity/campaigns → checkout returned 503 with correct Slovak message and NO 500. /donate on same campaign still works — proves both endpoints share db.campaigns. Grep confirmed routes/gateway.py:219,270 and routes/neural.py:38,147,281 all read/write db.campaigns. (B) IP PROTECTION LAYER — /api/origin returns full proof_of_origin record (codebase_sha256 c69321d7…, did did:guardian:pex:sha256:…, build GA-ORIGINAL-C69321D7, anchored:true, kind:proof_of_origin, blockchain_anchor with OpenTimestamps calendars) with NO auth — as required. Every response carries watermark headers X-Guardian-Origin: GA-ORIGINAL-C69321D7 and X-Origin-DID: did:guardian:pex:sha256:c693… — verified on /api/ (public), /api/auth/me (authed), /api/origin, and on 401 error responses (raw ASGI middleware stamps every code path, no perf regression). Regression smoke (auth/me, calendar/timeline, sentinel/aggregate, jarvis/context, chains/supply, gateway/grants, marketplace/offers, marketplace/me, gateway grant create+revoke) all 200. FRONTEND E2E (mobile 390×844): (1) /login renders with correct proprietary footer '© 2026 GUARDIAN ANGEL · PROPRIETARY · ZERO-KNOWLEDGE' — AGPL text removed ✓. (2) Hidden watermark GA-ORIGIN::GA-ORIGINAL-C69321D7::did:guardian:pex:sha256:… present in served DOM (grep-able for provenance) but rendered with opacity:0 and off-screen (left:-9999) — invisible to end user ✓. (3) After injecting gh_session_token='smoketok-fresh-2026' in localStorage, /profile Authorship block shows: 'Sole Visionary & Legal Owner: Guardian Angel' text ✓, testID='origin-did' displays the full DID ✓, and the build/anchored line 'Build GA-ORIGINAL-C69321D7 · anchored 2026-08-24' renders ✓. WATERMARK import from src/watermark.ts works, no crash. (4) /protocol loads all three sections with required testIDs pr-partner, pr-grant, pr-market-optin all present, no visible 404/error banner (iteration 13 fix confirmed at UI). (5) /solidarity renders 3 campaigns cleanly; opening the donate modal (PRISPIEŤ button) exposes both testID='donate-card' (Stripe path) and testID='donate-confirm' (community path); tapping donate-card triggers the fixed backend 503 and the UI now shows the friendly Slovak banner 'Platby kartou budú aktívne po doplnení reálneho Stripe kľúča — zatiaľ použite komunitný príspevok…' — NO MORE raw JSON leak (previous iteration 13 UI bug is also gone). Zero page-errors, zero red screens across the 4 routes tested.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/gateway.py:219,270 — CONFIRMED FIXED: both reads and writes now use db.campaigns (matches routes/legacy.py:50 persistence). Stripe checkout can now reach the _stripe_ready() guard and returns the intended 503 stripe_key_missing with the test key. Once a real STRIPE_API_KEY is deployed, checkout will proceed against the actual campaign and Stripe-callback update will correctly $inc raised_amount on the same collection.
routes/neural.py:38,147,281 — all three campaigns queries use db.campaigns consistently with legacy.py. Jarvis context and chains/supply verified end-to-end (200).

server.py GuardianWatermarkASGI — clean raw-ASGI middleware; injects headers via message['headers'].append inside send_wrapped only on http.response.start. Zero extra async round-trips vs. BaseHTTPMiddleware (per team note the old middleware pushed p95 above 2000ms; raw ASGI restores headroom). Headers correctly attach on 200s, 401s, and 4xx paths.

routes/origin.py — Public route (no auth), reads latest anchored record from db.ip_protection sorted by anchored_at DESC, falls back to origin.json + anchored:false when DB is empty. Idempotent anchoring on startup via $setOnInsert on {kind, codebase_sha256} — safe across restarts.

frontend/src/watermark.ts — GA_ORIGIN_MARK uses zero-width joiners (\u200b) around a grep-able 'GA-ORIGIN::...' signature. Rendered in _layout.tsx inside a Text with opacity:0, position:absolute, left:-9999, size 1x1, accessibilityElementsHidden, importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' — invisible to sighted users AND screen readers. Persistent in the JS bundle for provenance.

frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx About block — clean, monospaced DID + build line, uses testID='origin-did' as spec'd. Author credit line explicitly reads 'Sole Visionary & Legal Owner: Guardian Angel'.
frontend/app/login.tsx footer — AGPL text fully removed, footer reads '© 2026 GUARDIAN ANGEL · PROPRIETARY · ZERO-KNOWLEDGE' as required.
frontend/app/solidarity.tsx donate-card handler — verified in-UI that any non-2xx (503 in this case) maps to the Slovak Stripe-not-configured banner; no raw JSON leaks.
